messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — gcp-asia-south1 interconnect path instability detected for Private deployments. Elevated 5xx rates (50-70%) hitting private endpoints using VLAN 200 -> seen from 2024-11-12T11:02:14Z. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/priv-nw/gcp-interconnect?panel=5 :thumbsup:

mike-sre: oncall here. I'm seeing BGP session flaps on our Cloud Router (peer 35.203.18.7). Routes for onprem prefixes (10.40.0.0/16) withdrawn intermittently, leads to traffic blackholing then failover. Private DNS forwarding to our VPC DNS is showing high latencies as well. Paging neteng now.

anna-neteng: looking. Cloud Router logs show repeated "bgp session reset" entries ~ every 40s. AS path alternates between our AS and an upstream transit. Snap of router status:
```
$ gcloud compute routers get-status redwood-gcr-asia-south1 --region asia-south1
status: {
  bgpPeers: [ { name: peer-35-203, state: ESTABLISHED, uptime: 00:20:12 }, { name: peer-35-210, state: ACTIVE, uptime: 00:00:12 } ]
}
```
I think primary interconnect (VLAN 200) is flapping, causing downstream DNS queries to hit an overloaded secondary path. Opening GCP case and pulling packet samples.

mike-sre: confirmed impact to affected customers: embedding throughput for private deployments drops, requests hit timeouts then fallback to hosted model in some configs, causing token blowouts and cost spikes. Immediate mitigation options: 1) advertise more-specific routes via backup peering (manual route prep), 2) blackhole the unstable path and force failover to colo->public egress path, 3) ask GCP to stabilize Cloud Router session. I'm going to trigger (2) as it's fastest.

matthias-platform: +1 on forcing egress to colo secondary. Prep: add route preference to prefer path via hw-colo-02 (next-hop 192.168.254.1). I can push via terraform state override but will do manual route tweak first.

anna-neteng: pushing command to set next-hop-priority on our onprem routers and cloud routes. Runbook snippet:
```
# change BGP local-preference on iron01 to prefer backup path
vty# conf t
router bgp 64512
  neighbor 10.0.0.2 route-map PREFER-BACKUP in
route-map PREFER-BACKUP permit 10
  set local-preference 200
```
I will also lower DNS forwarder TTL to 30s to reduce stale data.

julie-cs: Customer-facing note: Accounts flagged: FinCo (acct-zen-01) and HealthAI (acct-zen-05) reporting 502/504s to private endpoints since ~11:02Z. CS notified both, raising interim tickets and offering workaround: switch to Hosted endpoint in eu-west while we mitigate. FinCo requests timeline.

mike-sre: executing manual route preference change now (step 1). Logging commands:
```
# cloud route patch to prefer backup path
gcloud compute routes update redwood-onprem-route --next-hop-address=192.168.254.1 --priority=100
```
Applying...

incident-bot: deploy-bot: route-change job started by mike-sre at 11:10Z. Job id: deploy-7832. Reactions: :rocket:.

gcp-se: GCP case 123456789 opened, severity P2. We're seeing packet drops on the fabric between interconnect peering location and the Cloud Router. Our network team is running link diagnostics and will attempt to quiesce the affected peer. ETA preliminary 20-30m. Will update with root cause once debug completes.

eva-oncall: taking over primary triage (handing off from mike-sre). Summary: primary interconnect VLAN 200 flapping -> route withdrawals -> high 5xx on private endpoints and DNS slowness. Mitigation performed: manual route preference to colo backup, TTL lowered at DNS forwarders, GCP case open. Accepting pager for next 2 hours.

mike-sre: handoff ack. Notes: watch for token usage spike due to fallback to hosted endpoints (we saw 3x tokens for embedding requests during 11:05-11:12). Also watch for errors from integration tests that rely on private DNS.

anna-neteng: GCP reports they applied a temporary fix at 11:28Z — Cloud Router session stabilized and BGP flaps stopped. Monitoring shows 5xx rate decreasing toward baseline. Graph: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/priv-nw/gcp-interconnect?panel=5&from=now-1h

julie-cs: update to customers: FinCo accepted hosted fallback for now; HealthAI requested post-incident call — scheduled for 16:00Z. Both accounts want incident summary and confirmation of isolation plan.

eva-oncall: running validation: synthetic checks to private endpoints from onprem and via colo look normal. TLS handshakes succeed, p95 latency back to normal. Continuing 1h of high-frequency checks.

matthias-platform: created private ticket PP-402 for long-term change: add automatic interconnect health-monitoring + automated route-failover runbook. Also adding alert rule to signal BGP flaps earlier.

gcp-se: final update on case 123456789: transient fiber-side flaps at IX node caused intermittent drops; cleared by vendor after patch at 11:27Z. Recommend we keep existing manual mitigations for 12h then revert route preference once stable.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS — mitigated. Severity P2 -> reduced impact. Timeline: start 1758881234, mitigated 1758883880, closed 1758885434. Next steps: postmortem (owner: matthias-platform), customer comms draft (owner: julie-cs), add alerting playbook (owner: anna-neteng).

julie-cs: drafting customer-facing post-incident note. Holding for final confirmation before send.

eva-oncall: closing handoff — will publish SRE timeline + logs to the incident tracker. If anything recurs, re-open pager. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
